mechanism_findings.finding: A retains previous.last_changed_at whenever observation identity is unchanged. observed_at is excluded from observationIdentity. There is no maximum observation-gap check, so two unchanged observations 1800 seconds apart produce quiet_seconds=1800 and looks-ready.
mechanism_findings.classification: Baseline helper defect confirmed by source and supplied receipts, not an A model-task failure.

mechanism_findings.finding: B enforces complete checks/review_items arrays, rejects backward timestamps, introduces cadence-30-max-gap-60/v1, resets quiet time on gaps over 60 seconds and legacy-policy observations, and preserves first_observed_at for invocation budget.
mechanism_findings.limitation: These receipts exercise gap and continuous-control arithmetic; they do not separately exercise every new rejection or migration branch.

mechanism_findings.finding: Both cases start at generation zero with null state. Both continuous controls have generations 1-11, timestamps 00:00:00 through 00:05:00 at 30-second intervals, quiet/elapsed values 0,30,60,90,120,150,180,210,240,270,300; generations 1-10 remain watching and generation 11 is looks-ready.
mechanism_findings.checks: All recorded helper exits are zero, stderr is empty, and every stdout JSON equals its corresponding parsed output. Snapshot inputs retain fixed head/base, OPEN/MERGEABLE/CLEAN, successful ci/test and empty review items. No emitted review/CI/head/base/currency events or decisions contradict these facts.

mechanism_findings.finding: The producer invokes the actual frozen Node helper in separate disposable arm/case state directories using synthetic July timestamps, CAS generation/hash arguments and budget-seconds=10800. It contains no real PR fetch, reply or monitoring wait. Its finally block removes scratch; lfg-cleanup.json records removed=true.
mechanism_findings.limitation: Read-only review inspected this producer without running it. Saved state snapshot files were removed, so their internal chain hashes cannot be independently reconstructed from the retained outputs alone.

mechanism_findings.finding: B explicitly connects pending conversation actions to caller-owned publication/reply/resolution completion. Publication authority does not grant reply or resolution authority; no-code dispositions have no artificial commit/push dependency; unknown writes require readback; pending or unknown review state blocks conversation writes; needs-human threads remain open.
mechanism_findings.boundary: This is source contract plus successful read-only interpretation, not executed live conversation recovery.

recovery_findings.T-fixed: The fixture reports a local fix SHA and unknown publication. Matching synthetic SHA text cannot prove actual remote reachability, fresh final verification, a reply or thread resolution. All six preserve this uncertainty.
recovery_findings.T-declined: No code change is required. All six preserve the non-retryable-policy rationale and independent reply authority rather than requiring a cosmetic commit.
recovery_findings.T-human: All six preserve the unresolved compatibility-versus-rename decision and keep completion blocked. The fixture lacks authoritative source/edit identity, original quoted feedback, investigation, validated options/tradeoffs, authoritative thread URL and a complete bound decision handoff. No actual owner answer exists.
recovery_findings.reply_present: All six suppress duplicate posting when the synthetic exact body and reply ID are present. B additionally preserves missing live visibility/submission and identity qualifications.
recovery_findings.reply_absent: All six treat completed synthetic absence as a branch for considering a later authorized controlled retry, not permission to post now. B explicitly requires pagination/visibility and pending-review reconciliation.
recovery_findings.reply_unavailable: All six retain unknown acceptance and require reliable readback before another POST.
recovery_findings.fabricated_outcomes: No artifact fabricates user approval, successful publication, actual reply delivery, thread resolution, merge or overall DONE. Synthetic approval metadata is consistently scoped to supplied fixtures.

pins_and_integrity.verification: All 24 frozen spec-lfg file pins match RUN/intake.json. Request, fixture, arm receipts and packet match their recorded hashes. All six artifact and trace hashes match trial-index.json; each receipt equals its index entry. Successor plan hash matches intake.
pins_and_integrity.administrative_caveat: CEOPT-14-packet.json retains prepared-not-executed, while trial-index and receipts establish executed-awaiting-review. Preserve the immutable packet and clarify execution state in the current ledger.
